sources.title: Merchant Shipping MRV revocation regulations 2026
facts: DfT records revocation of the legacy UK maritime MRV instruments as UK ETS maritime monitoring/reporting replaces that regime from July 2026.
Revocation/currentity evidence changes the applicable reporting regime; it is not a parcel greenhouse-gas measurement.

sources.title: Withdrawn MIN 669 detailed UK MRV reporting guidance
facts: The withdrawn MIN 669 detail page records that legacy UK MRV data up to 3 April 2026 remains subject to legacy verification while UK ETS maritime replaces the old regime.
A withdrawn transition document must not be treated as the current UK ETS maritime monitoring contract.

sources.title: Withdrawn MIN 669 UK MRV publication parent
facts: The publication parent identifies MIN 669 as withdrawn and points to the transition from legacy ship MRV to UK ETS maritime.
Publication-status metadata is provenance/currentity evidence, not physical emissions.

sources.title: CORSIA: how to comply
facts: CORSIA guidance requires monitoring and verified reporting of CO2 from international flights and separately defines offsetting obligations.
CORSIA international-flight emissions and offset units are not land-parcel emissions and must remain distinct from UK ETS aviation.

sources.title: Manage your UK Emissions Trading Scheme reporting gateway
facts: METS is the online reporting service used by UK ETS/CORSIA operators, regulators and verifiers for permits, monitoring plans and annual reports.
A reporting-service interface or task state is not itself an observed emissions value.

sources.title: UK ETS activity level report template
facts: DESNZ updated the activity-level reporting template after correcting a formula and requires relevant operators to submit activity-level reports.
Activity-level reporting data and templates affect free allocation administration and are not parcel emissions measurements.

sources.title: UK ETS verification report template
facts: The DESNZ verification template is used by accredited verifiers for operators' activity-level reports.
A verification template records assurance workflow and does not itself prove a physical parcel emissions value.

sources.title: UK ETS baseline data collection and HSE/USE status guidance
facts: DESNZ guidance describes the two-stage free-allocation application and HSE/USE baseline-data requirements, including the 2026 second stage.
Baseline/application data, HSE/USE status and free-allocation eligibility must not be interpreted as parcel emissions measurements.

sources.title: ONS greenhouse gas emissions intensity by industry dataset
facts: ONS publishes greenhouse-gas emissions intensity by economic sector with current and provisional editions under Environmental Accounts.
An intensity ratio is not an absolute site or parcel emissions measurement and the accounting basis must be preserved.

sources.title: ONS greenhouse gas emissions intensity by industry current edition
facts: The current ONS intensity edition records scheduled revisions and a March 2026 correction affecting parts of the historical series.
Corrected/current intensity values must supersede affected older files while remaining distinct from absolute parcel emissions.

sources.title: NAEI greenhouse gas emissions data catalogue
facts: NAEI lists the 2026 UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory 1990-2024, devolved inventories and national data products with next-publication timing.
A catalogue establishes dataset provenance/currentity and is not itself a numeric parcel observation.

sources.title: UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory 1990 to 2024 annual report
facts: NAEI's 2026 National Inventory Document covers UK greenhouse-gas inventory years 1990-2024 and links annexes and supporting background data.
National inventory totals, annexes and factors require explicit scope and spatial binding before any parcel attribution.

sources.title: NAEI devolved government greenhouse gas emissions
facts: NAEI states devolved inventories are consistent with the UK UNFCCC inventory and distinguishes by-source from end-user presentations.
England/devolved totals and source/end-user reallocations are aggregate inventory evidence, not parcel measurements.

sources.title: NAEI UK emissions data selector
facts: The NAEI selector exposes UK emissions by pollutant, sector, category and source and documents unit caveats for individual gases.
Selector results require correct gas units, national-total rules and scope interpretation; they do not create parcel binding.

sources.title: NAEI data landing page
facts: NAEI's data landing page links UK totals, selectors, maps, devolved reports, local-authority data and the data archive.
A data-navigation page identifies provenance and products but is not a greenhouse-gas measurement.

sources.title: NAEI UK totals methodology and data page
facts: NAEI explains that international submissions are by-source while selected inventories are also produced on an end-user basis.
By-source and end-user accounting bases cannot be mixed or assigned directly to individual parcels.

sources.title: UK ETS carbon price for civil penalties 2026
facts: The UK ETS Authority determined the 2026 carbon price used under the civil-penalty provisions from secondary-market settlement prices.
A statutory penalty carbon price is monetary compliance data, not a physical emissions measurement.

sources.title: UK ETS guidance for ultra-small emitters
facts: USE installations must monitor emissions and notify regulators when emissions exceed the scheme threshold; qualifying lists are allocation-period specific.
A USE threshold or status does not establish a parcel emissions value and must not be treated as one.

sources.title: UK ETS reports and scheme reviews collection
facts: The DESNZ collection links carbon-market performance, allocation tables and HSE emissions/target reporting surfaces.
Collection metadata and scheme-review outputs are provenance/policy evidence, not parcel measurements.

sources.title: UK ETS treatment of sustainable aviation fuel consultation
facts: The UK ETS Authority consulted on future treatment of SAF emissions reductions and interaction with the SAF Mandate.
Consultation options are policy proposals, not observed aviation or parcel emissions.

sources.title: UK ETS cross-boundary CCS pipelines consultation accessible webpage
facts: The Authority consulted on simplifying UK ETS permitting, monitoring and enforcement for cross-boundary CO2 transport pipelines.
A CCS regulatory boundary or permit architecture is not a land-parcel emissions measurement.

sources.title: Taking part in the UK Emissions Trading Scheme markets
facts: DESNZ explains UKA auctions, secondary-market trading, auction reserve price and Cost Containment Mechanism rules.
Allowance supply, auction prices and market triggers are compliance/market data, not physical emissions observations.

sources.title: UK ETS policy overview
facts: The UK ETS policy overview records current policy development, including 2026 auction reserve price changes and live consultations.
Policy and cap design describe scheme rules and incentives but do not measure parcel emissions.

sources.title: Environmental taxes and reliefs: UK ETS overview
facts: GOV.UK's business overview explains annual verified reporting and the obligation to surrender allowances for covered emissions.
A business compliance overview and allowance obligation are not independent parcel emissions evidence.

sources.title: Greenhouse gas reporting conversion factors 2026
facts: DESNZ publishes 2026 Scope 1, 2 and 3 conversion factors for calculating emissions from supported activity data.
A conversion factor alone is not an emissions observation; it needs applicable activity data, scope, units and reporting period.
